verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory fee amounts is a fair question for a business-filing registry. However, none of the evidence items state any fee amounts. They cover filing types, account features, US Bank payment and Revenue department links, and the probes show the main sos.state.mn.us site is behind a CAPTCHA wall, so no published fee schedule is evidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
